recipes.title: Soft Fresh Summer Savory, Goat Cheese & Spinach Scramble
recipes.summary: Tender low-heat scrambled eggs brightened with delicate peppery leaves of fresh summer savory, wilted baby spinach, olive oil, and creamy goat cheese.
steps: Warm olive oil over medium-low heat and wilt baby spinach with half the fresh summer savory 1 minute.
Pour in lightly beaten eggs and fold gently 2 to 3 minutes until soft curds form.
Remove from heat, dot with soft goat cheese and remaining fresh summer savory, and serve warm.
tips: Fresh summer savory has a tender, peppery thyme-and-marjoram aroma that gives eggs garden elegance without harsh spice.
Simply run fingers down the tender green stems to strip the tiny leaves.

recipes.title: Provençal Fresh Summer Savory & White Bean Toast
recipes.summary: Warm cannellini beans gently simmered with garlic, olive oil, lemon, and fresh summer savory—Europe's classic bean herb—spooned onto whole-grain toast.
steps: Warm olive oil over low heat and cook minced garlic and half the summer savory 45 seconds until fragrant.
Add rinsed cannellini beans and 3 tbsp water; simmer 4 minutes and mash half the beans softly with a fork.
Stir in lemon juice and remaining fresh summer savory and pile onto warm whole-grain toast.
tips: In Germany and France, summer savory is nicknamed the 'bean herb' (Bohnenkraut) because it makes legumes taste luminous and gentle on digestion.
Top with a soft poached egg whenever you want extra protein.

recipes.title: Golden Baby Potato & Fresh Summer Savory Breakfast Hash
recipes.summary: Crisp-tender diced baby potatoes sautéed in olive oil with sweet onion, fresh summer savory leaves, and soft skillet-steamed eggs.
steps: Cook diced baby potatoes and onion in olive oil with 2 tbsp water covered 7 minutes until tender.
Uncover, stir in chopped fresh summer savory, and saute 4 minutes until lightly golden.
Crack two eggs into shallow wells in the hash, cover, and cook 3 to 4 minutes until softly set.
tips: Fresh summer savory brings bright peppery zest so you barely need any extra salt or black pepper.
One pan from start to table.

recipes.title: Warm Fresh Summer Savory, Mushroom & Olive Oil Oats
recipes.summary: Soothing broth-cooked rolled oats crowned with golden mushrooms scented with fresh summer savory, olive oil, and grated Parmesan.
steps: Simmer rolled oats and vegetable broth 6 to 7 minutes until velvety soft.
Meanwhile saute sliced mushrooms in olive oil 5 minutes until golden, stirring in fresh summer savory during the last minute.
Spoon creamy oats into a warm bowl and crown with the fragrant mushrooms and Parmesan.
tips: Soft, hearty whole-grain comfort with bright Mediterranean herb notes.
Mushrooms and fresh summer savory harmonize effortlessly.

recipes.title: Whipped Ricotta, Sweet Tomato & Fresh Summer Savory Toast
recipes.summary: Crisp whole-grain toast spread with cool part-skim ricotta, juicy cherry tomato halves, extra-virgin olive oil, and tender fresh summer savory.
steps: Toast whole-grain bread until crisp and spread generously with ricotta cheese.
Nestle halved sweet cherry tomatoes cut-side up into the ricotta.
Scatter fresh summer savory leaves across top and finish with extra-virgin olive oil.
tips: Fresh summer savory leaves are small and tender enough to sprinkle raw right over ripe tomatoes.
Ready in 7 minutes with zero stovetop cooking.

recipes.title: German-Style Green Bean, Baby Potato & Summer Savory Salad
recipes.summary: Classic German Bohnensalat pairing tender steamed green beans and baby potatoes with apple cider vinegar, olive oil, white beans, and fresh summer savory.
steps: Boil halved baby potatoes 8 minutes, then add bite-size green beans to the same pot and boil 6 more minutes until both are tender; drain well.
Whisk extra-virgin olive oil, apple cider vinegar, chopped fresh summer savory, and a pinch of salt in a bowl.
Toss warm potatoes, green beans, and white beans gently with the fragrant dressing and serve warm or room temperature.
tips: Green beans and fresh summer savory (Bohnenkraut) are one of Central Europe's oldest culinary pairings.
Cooking potatoes and green beans in one pot keeps dishwashing minimal.

recipes.title: Provençal Green Lentil, Carrot & Fresh Summer Savory Soup
recipes.summary: Nourishing French countryside soup simmering green lentils, carrots, celery, garlic, and sprigs of fresh summer savory into a fragrant broth.

ingredient_details.note: plus 1 tsp chopped leaves for finish

steps: Saute finely diced carrots and celery in olive oil 5 minutes until softened, then stir in minced garlic 45 seconds.
Add cooked lentils, vegetable broth, and fresh summer savory sprigs; simmer gently 12 minutes.
Remove woody stems, ladle warm into bowls, and scatter fresh chopped summer savory leaves over top.
tips: Summer savory traditionally pairs with lentils across Provence to give deep warmth and easy digestibility.
Brighten each bowl with a squeeze of lemon if desired.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Chickpea, Tomato & Summer Savory Bowl
recipes.summary: Crisp no-cook lunch tossing tender chickpeas, sweet cherry tomatoes, diced cucumber, feta, lemon, olive oil, and fresh summer savory.
steps: Whisk extra-virgin olive oil, fresh lemon juice, chopped summer savory, and a pinch of salt in a bowl.
Add rinsed chickpeas, cherry tomatoes, and diced cucumber and toss evenly.
Top with crumbled feta and serve cool.
tips: A crisp, light, zero-stove Mediterranean lunch bursting with garden freshness.
Swap feta for diced avocado for a dairy-free bowl.

recipes.title: Warm Poached Chicken, Cannellini & Summer Savory Salad
recipes.summary: Moist shredded poached chicken and creamy cannellini beans warmed lightly with olive oil, baby spinach, lemon, and abundant fresh summer savory.
steps: Warm olive oil over medium-low heat and infuse garlic and half the fresh summer savory 45 seconds.
Fold in cannellini beans, shredded poached chicken, and 2 tbsp water and warm gently 3 minutes.
Turn off heat, fold in baby spinach until wilted, and finish with lemon juice and remaining fresh summer savory.
tips: Combines tender lean chicken and soft white beans for an effortless, filling warm lunch.
Delicious at room temperature too.

recipes.title: Silky Garden Zucchini, Potato & Summer Savory Soup
recipes.summary: Light, creamy dairy-free summer soup blending tender zucchini, Yukon Gold potato, sweet onion, olive oil, and fragrant fresh summer savory.
steps: Soften onion in olive oil 4 minutes, then add sliced zucchini, diced potato, vegetable broth, and half the summer savory.
Simmer gently 12 minutes until potato is fork-tender.
Blend silky smooth with an immersion blender, stir in remaining fresh summer savory, and ladle warm.
tips: One Yukon Gold potato gives delicate zucchini soup velvety body without heavy cream.
Soft, hydrating, and soothing to swallow.

recipes.title: Provençal Fresh Summer Savory Chicken & Green Bean Skillet
recipes.summary: Juicy skillet-braised chicken thighs simmered with garlic, white beans, green beans, lemon, and abundant fresh summer savory.
steps: Brown chicken thighs lightly in 1 tbsp olive oil 3 minutes per side, then add sliced garlic, half the summer savory, and chicken broth; cover and simmer 8 minutes.
Nestle green beans and cannellini beans around the chicken, cover, and simmer 6 more minutes until chicken hits 165 F and green beans are tender.
Finish with fresh lemon juice and remaining bright summer savory leaves.
tips: Summer savory is a cornerstone of authentic Herbes de Provence—wonderful with tender poultry and beans.
One skillet holds protein, fiber, and green veggies cleanly.

recipes.title: Herb-Baked Salmon with Fresh Summer Savory & Lemon Potatoes
recipes.summary: Moist oven-baked salmon fillets and halved baby potatoes roasted together with extra-virgin olive oil, garlic, lemon, and fragrant fresh summer savory.
steps: Heat oven to 400 F; toss baby potatoes with 1 tbsp olive oil and half the summer savory on a lined sheet pan and roast 10 minutes first.
Nestle salmon fillets onto the pan, brush with remaining oil, garlic, and lemon juice, and roast 10 to 12 minutes until fish flakes softly.
Scatter remaining fresh summer savory across both fish and potatoes to serve.
tips: Fresh summer savory's crisp peppery-citrus flavor balances rich omega-3 salmon cleanly.
Pair with steamed baby spinach or peas.

recipes.title: Cozy Summer Savory, Black Bean & Sweet Potato Stew
recipes.summary: Hearty plant-based one-pot stew simmering sweet potato cubes, black beans, crushed tomatoes, onion, and generous fresh summer savory.
steps: Soften diced onion in olive oil 4 minutes, then stir in sweet potato cubes and half the fresh summer savory.
Add black beans, diced tomatoes, and vegetable broth; cover and simmer 16 minutes until sweet potato is spoon-soft.
Fold in the remaining bright summer savory leaves and ladle warm into bowls.
tips: Black beans and summer savory are an unforgettable herb-legume partnership—rich, soothing, and high in fiber.
Serve over soft brown rice or warm corn tortillas.

recipes.title: One-Pan Poached Cod in Cherry Tomato & Summer Savory Broth
recipes.summary: Melt-in-your-mouth cod fillets poached gently in burst sweet cherry tomatoes, garlic, olive oil, and fresh summer savory sprigs.
steps: Simmer cherry tomatoes, sliced garlic, olive oil, vegetable broth, and half the summer savory 5 minutes until tomatoes soften and burst.
Nestle cod fillets into the simmering sauce, cover, and gently poach 8 minutes until flaky.
Finish with lemon juice and remaining fresh summer savory leaves and serve over creamy polenta or rice.
tips: Super-soft fish and jammy tomatoes require minimal chewing effort.
Ready in 20 minutes with one pan.

recipes.title: Savory Mushroom, White Bean & Summer Savory Farro Skillet
recipes.summary: Earthy cremini mushrooms, creamy white beans, and cooked farro tossed with olive oil, garlic, baby spinach, and fresh summer savory.
steps: Saute sliced mushrooms in olive oil 6 minutes until browned, then stir in minced garlic and half the summer savory 45 seconds.
Add cooked farro, white beans, and 3 tbsp water; warm 3 minutes until glossy.
Turn off heat, fold in baby spinach until wilted and scatter remaining fresh summer savory across top.
tips: Cooked pearl barley or quinoa swaps smoothly for farro.
Sprinkle lightly with Parmesan or toasted walnuts if desired.

recipes.title: Blueberry, Greek Yogurt & Summer Savory Infusion Smoothie
recipes.summary: Bright botanical berry smoothie uniting chilled freshly steeped summer savory herbal tea, frozen blueberries, Greek yogurt, banana, and honey.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in 1/2 cup hot water 4 minutes and strained

steps: Steep fresh summer savory sprigs in 1/2 cup hot water covered 4 minutes, strain cleanly, and chill with 3 ice cubes.
Combine chilled summer savory infusion, Greek yogurt, frozen blueberries, banana, and honey in a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until deep violet and velvety smooth.
tips: Steeping fresh summer savory into a fragrant herbal tea first ensures silky smoothness while capturing its bright citrus-thyme aroma.
Caffeine-free and packed with berry antioxidants.

recipes.title: Sweet Peach, Rolled Oat & Summer Savory Tea Smoothie
recipes.summary: Sunny dairy-free breakfast smoothie blending frozen peaches, rolled oats, oat milk, vanilla, and chilled brewed fresh summer savory infusion.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in 1/3 cup hot water 4 minutes and strained

steps: Steep fresh summer savory sprigs in 1/3 cup hot water covered 4 minutes, strain, and chill with 2 ice cubes.
Blend chilled infusion, oat milk, rolled oats, frozen peaches, and vanilla 55 seconds until thick and smooth.
Serve cold right away.
tips: Summer stone fruit and fresh summer savory harmonize into a crisp, uplifting garden blend.
Sustaining whole-grain fiber with zero added sweetener.

recipes.title: Juicy Pear, Spinach & Fresh Summer Savory Green Smoothie
recipes.summary: Crisp green garden smoothie blending ripe pear, baby spinach, tender fresh summer savory leaves, lemon juice, banana, and cold water.
steps: Blend cold water, baby spinach, and fresh summer savory leaves 20 seconds until completely liquefied.
Add diced ripe pear, frozen banana, and lemon juice and blend 35 seconds until silky bright green.
Pour into a glass and enjoy cold.
tips: Tender young summer savory leaves blend smoothly right alongside baby spinach.
Naturally dairy-free and refreshing.

recipes.title: Strawberry, Kefir & Summer Savory Tea Probiotic Smoothie
recipes.summary: Cultured probiotic smoothie uniting chilled brewed summer savory tea, plain kefir, frozen strawberries, banana, and a drop of honey.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in 1/3 cup hot water 4 minutes and strained

steps: Steep fresh summer savory sprigs in 1/3 cup hot water covered 4 minutes, strain cleanly, and chill with 2 ice cubes.
Blend chilled herb infusion, plain kefir, frozen strawberries, banana, and honey 45 seconds until silky pink.
Serve cold immediately.
tips: Sweet strawberries and tangy kefir soften summer savory into a bright, pleasant berry smoothie.
Gentle probiotics and caffeine-free hydration.

recipes.title: Golden Mango, Pineapple & Summer Savory Citrus Smoothie
recipes.summary: Vibrant yellow tropical smoothie combining chilled brewed summer savory infusion, frozen mango, pineapple, and fresh lime juice.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in 3/4 cup hot water 4 minutes and chilled

steps: Steep fresh summer savory sprigs in 3/4 cup hot water covered 4 minutes, strain, and chill over ice.
Blend chilled infusion, frozen mango, frozen pineapple, and lime juice 45 seconds until frothy golden.
Pour into a tall glass and sip cold.
tips: Summer savory adds crisp botanical intrigue to classic sweet tropical fruit.
100% plant-based and nut-free.

recipes.title: Iced Fresh Summer Savory, Lemon & Honey Garden Spritz
recipes.summary: Crisp French-garden herbal cooler steeping fresh summer savory sprigs with honey, freshly squeezed lemon juice, and sparkling water.
steps: Steep fresh summer savory sprigs and honey in 3/4 cup hot water covered 5 minutes, then strain cleanly.
Stir in freshly squeezed lemon juice and pour over ice cubes in two tall glasses.
Top with chilled sparkling water and serve crisp.
tips: Summer savory tea has been treasured across Southern Europe as an uplifting digestive herbal drink.
Still cold water works equally nicely if you avoid carbonation.

recipes.title: Pressed Apple, Ginger & Fresh Summer Savory Cooler
recipes.summary: Orchard-sweet pressed apple juice gently infused with fresh summer savory sprigs, ginger, and lemon, served iced or lightly warmed.
steps: Warm apple juice gently with fresh summer savory sprigs and ginger slices 3 minutes without boiling, then steep 3 minutes off heat.
Strain cleanly and stir in fresh lemon juice.
Serve chilled over ice cubes (or warm in mugs on cool afternoons).
tips: No added sweetener needed—apple juice carries summer savory's gentle peppery notes gracefully.
Naturally caffeine-free.

recipes.title: Cool Cucumber, Lime & Fresh Summer Savory Spa Press
recipes.summary: Clean green spa press blending chopped cucumber, fresh summer savory leaves, lime juice, and chilled water, strained spotless over ice.
steps: Blend chopped cucumber, chilled water, fresh summer savory leaves, lime juice, and honey 20 seconds.
Strain cleanly through a fine sieve over ice cubes.
Serve immediately while frosty green and crisp.
tips: No juicer needed—a quick blend and strain extracts clear botanical garden juice.
Hydrating, crisp, and very low in sugar.

recipes.title: Sweet Orange, Pear & Brewed Summer Savory Press
recipes.summary: Bright Mediterranean fruit press layering freshly squeezed orange juice, pure pear juice, and chilled brewed fresh summer savory tea over ice.
steps: Steep fresh summer savory sprigs in 1/3 cup hot water covered 4 minutes, then strain.
Pour the fragrant infusion, orange juice, and pure pear juice over ice cubes.
Stir gently and enjoy cold.
tips: Sweet orange and mellow pear round out fresh summer savory cleanly with zero added syrup.
Refreshing alongside a light lunch.

recipes.title: Garden Tomato, Lemon & Fresh Summer Savory Press
recipes.summary: Crisp chilled vegetable tonic pulsing low-sodium tomato juice with fresh summer savory leaves, lemon juice, and olive oil, strained smooth.
steps: Pulse chilled tomato juice, fresh summer savory leaves, lemon juice, and olive oil 15 seconds.
Strain through a fine sieve over ice cubes for a silky garden pour.
Enjoy chilled as a bright savory refresher.
tips: Summer savory's natural peppery snap makes tomato juice sing without needing hot sauce or heavy salt.
Half a teaspoon of olive oil boosts tomato lycopene absorption.
